title: Willa the Little Plane and the Quiet Sky
description: A small sky-blue plane flies one calm evening loop over town, watches the lights come on, and glides home when the moon is up.

Willa.role: Main character; a little propeller plane
Willa.color: Sky-blue body with cream wings and one small yellow star on the tail
Willa.bodyShape: Small single-engine plane with a front propeller, cream wings, and no human-like arms or hands
Willa.face: Two bright friendly eyes on the nose and a gentle smile under the propeller
Willa.wheels: Two small cream landing wheels that stay the same
Willa.accessories: One yellow tail star and a soft engine glow, with no numbers, letters, or logos

settingBible.Quiet Sky: A grass airfield with one gold runway light, a river, a town of rooftops, a park, a moonlit hill, pink evening clouds, and a small hangar
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded forms, one scene per page, calm evening flight colors, and no readable text

continuityRules: Willa stays sky-blue with cream wings, one yellow tail star, the same propeller, eyes, smile, and two cream wheels.
Willa has no human-like arms or hands; a wing dip is the plane herself tilting.
This is one calm evening loop with no breakdown, rescue, or repair.
The sky moves from quiet evening to moonrise and a gentle landing.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or watermark.

pages.text: Evening was quiet, and Willa's cream wings rested on the grass.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa rests on the grass airfield at evening with her cream wings still and her sky-blue body showing.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock sky-blue body, cream wings, yellow tail star, propeller, eyes, smile, and two cream wheels.

pages.text: One gold runway light said the sky was clear, but the evening stayed hushed.
pages.illustrationScene: One gold runway light glows ahead of Willa on the quiet grass field under a clear hushed sky.
pages.continuityNotes: Exactly one gold runway light. No storm and no rush.

pages.text: Willa rolled forward, soft and straight.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa rolls softly and straight along the grass toward the gold runway light.
pages.continuityNotes: Wheels down. Same design. Motion is gentle.

pages.text: She lifted, and the town became rooftops and trees.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa lifts into the evening sky as rooftops and trees shrink gently below her.
pages.continuityNotes: Takeoff is smooth. Wheels still visible but tucked in look stays simple and consistent.

pages.text: She followed the river, a silver ribbon below.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa flies above a silver river that winds like a ribbon through the land.
pages.continuityNotes: Same plane. River is calm and silver.

pages.text: Windows blinked on, one street at a time.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa looks down as town windows blink on one street at a time in the softening light.
pages.continuityNotes: Lights come on gradually. No emergency lights.

pages.text: She dipped a wing hello to the hill where the moon was rising.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa tilts one cream wing toward a hill where the moon is just rising.
pages.continuityNotes: Wing dip is a tilt, not an arm. Same yellow star stays visible.

pages.text: A line of birds flew home underneath her, unhurried and safe.
pages.illustrationScene: A small line of birds flies home below Willa, calm and unhurried, in the open sky.
pages.continuityNotes: Birds are a simple background line. No chase.

pages.text: She circled the park once, high and quiet.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa makes one high quiet circle above a sleepy park.
pages.continuityNotes: One circle only. Park is small and peaceful below.

pages.text: Pink clouds sat low, and Willa flew beside them.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa flies beside a low bank of pink clouds in the night-leaning sky.
pages.continuityNotes: Pink clouds stay low. Willa's colors unchanged.

pages.text: Far below, a string of lights moved through the valley, and she let it go.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa watches a distant string of valley lights pass far below and continues her own calm loop.
pages.continuityNotes: Distant lights only. She does not turn it into an errand.

pages.text: The runway light blinked again, gentle as a bedtime lamp.
pages.illustrationScene: The same gold runway light blinks softly below as Willa turns her nose toward the field.
pages.continuityNotes: Same single gold light as page 2, now a gentle blink.

pages.text: Willa turned for home with her engine a little softer.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa banks gently toward the grass field with a softer engine and the moon behind her.
pages.continuityNotes: Home turn is smooth. No trouble.

pages.text: Her wheels touched, and the grass whispered.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa's two cream wheels touch the grass in a soft landing.
pages.continuityNotes: Landing is gentle. Same two wheels.

pages.text: In the hangar, the yellow star on her tail was the last small glow, so goodnight, Willa.
pages.illustrationScene: Willa rests in the small hangar with the yellow star on her tail glowing softly as the last light.
pages.continuityNotes: Goodnight ending. All locked colors remain. She is at rest.
